description: Evaluating a free-substituted scoped term equals evaluating the original with replacement-term values assigned to free variables and the same scoped tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.scopedTermSubst_realize.{u, v, w, u', v'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} {β : Type v'} {n : ℕ} (t : L.Term (α ⊕ Fin n)) (σ : α → L.Term β)
  (a : β → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Sum.elim a b) (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.scopedTermSubst t σ) =
    FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Sum.elim (fun x => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize a (σ x)) b) t
